validation.long_case_evidence: CIGAR validity and internal certificate plus cross-mode agreement; no independent full optimum

timing_policy.primary: median internal total_ms across repeated identical inputs
timing_policy.clock: engine elapsed wall-clock milliseconds, not CPU cycles
timing_policy.aggregation: median of per-case medians; comparisons use sums of medians on identical shared cases
timing_policy.predictor_overhead: included in engine total_ms; predictor_ms retained separately
timing_policy.process_overhead: batch wall_ms includes process startup and I/O and is reported separately
timing_policy.external_baselines: none; no Edlib or WFA2 comparison
